result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with no critical visual breaks. One minor layout issue was identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, abruptly cutting off mid-word at the card boundary rather than gracefully truncating with '...'
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to restaurant name labels in the carousel cards to ensure truncated text is visually indicated properly
